subject: Where can I get the dataset mpg2?

messages.author: 725a19a4878ce2ea
messages.subject: Where can I get the dataset mpg2?
parts:
Dear list users,

 I would like to practice some examples in Hadley's ggplot2 book, which used dataset mpg2, but I could not find a clue how to get the data set. Thanks in advance.


Changhong

messages.author: de80823ab00b5d5b
messages.subject: Re: Where can I get the dataset mpg2?
parts:
mpg2 <- subset(mpg, cyl != 5 & drv %in% c("4", "f"))

pg 105 Section 7.2

Thanks very much for quick answer. I used R version 2.6.0 when I posted my previous email where dataset mpg is not included so that I could not make mpg2 from mpg. Then I realized this problem and installed R 2.8.1 where I saw mpg now.  I am really enjoying this powerful package.


Changhong
